[PvP Progression 4] All Enchants now cost 1k Arena Points from 1875 (to match pacing of this seasons PvP Progression) and require 1400 rating from 1850. All enchants are bind on use.

[PvP Progression 4] Introduced the Headsman Enchant. Headsman enchant has a chance to increase your damage done by 10% to targets below 20% health for 6 seconds. This effect can only occur every 10 seconds.

[PvP Progression 4] Introduced New Helm & Leg enchants as alternatives to ZG Helm & Leg Enchants. These Enchants will cost 1k Arena Points, will be bind on use and require 1400 rating. (in the next pvp progression, they will cost honor and require no rating)

[PvP Progression 4] Introduced New Shoulder Enchants as alternatives to ZG Shoulder Enchants. These enchants will cost 1k Arena Points, will be bind on use and require 1400 rating. (in the next pvp progression, they will cost honor and require no rating)

Vastly improved subpar itemization across the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj for non tier items.

Tier Items will follow this new itemization standard, here are the biggest changes!

- Druid Set (previously similarly statted like the Paladin Set) is now more focused towards Spirit & Spell Power like the Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 version.
- Paladin Set (had a slew of stats not changed since our stat allocation update) is more favoring Towards Strength, Critical Strike, some Haste and some Expertise.

Other tier items have had general itemization standard improved!

0.description: Fixed a bug where Prestiging would reward 500 marks of ascension. It will now reward 2500 Marks of Ascension.
These changes aim to remove an unfun and unnecessary RNG element when it comes to gearing and loot distribution allowing YOU to have a clearer path forward when it comes to gearing up your character.
After a server restart, your tier tokens will be updated to the newest token. These changes require you to clear your cache & update your patch via the launcher!

[Season 7]: Tier Tokens are no longer bound to Class Restrictions. Now upon receiving a Tier Token drop in Raid, you will be able to take it to the respective vendor and exchange said token for that any item that fits your Token slot. 

(This just means you can purchase a Tier 1 Helmet from the vendor if you have the Helmet Token, but you can not exchange a Helmet token for Platelegs)

This also allows for the new Tooltips to show & tell players where to exchange these tokens for gear.

This systemic change may come to Area-52 in the near future! Be sure to let us know your feedback of this new tier-gear distribution system.

Stay Frosty will no longer give you a 3rd Fingers of Death Charge after using Stormstrike while using Fingers of Death RE with Freezing Strikes. Instead the Fingers of Death charges gained will be equal to Fingers of Frost charges gained.
[Prestige]: The Bonus experience from the Open World daily is increased to 25% from 20%. Pending Patch Update.
Fixed an issue where some Bloodforged Weapons would have incorrect damage & stat numbers. This update requires a cleared cache to see the updated numbers.
